[EN] Claws for Concern

[EN] With my recommendation, even you could become Oshar's student.

Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Deliver the claws to {@linkcreature:230#1028$$Lihish}.
[ES] Entrégale las garras a {@linkcreature:230#1028$$Lihish}.

[EN] "Victory for Valkyon!"
